intent: Close the paired-score test's SQLite fixture connections deterministically while preserving transaction behavior, every permission assertion and cleanup failure visibility.

baseline_evidence.observed_failure: TemporaryDirectory cleanup raises PermissionError WinError32 for jobs.sqlite3 after the test's assertions, on both hosted Windows runtimes.
baseline_evidence.source_cause: The fixture's setup connection and three update connections use the sqlite3 transaction context without explicit closure. Production BenchmarkStore.db and retained_device_grant close their own connections in finally.
baseline_evidence.qualification: The logs do not identify which open OS handle caused the cleanup lock. This is a concrete fixture-resource defect, not evidence of a production database leak or a failed permission assertion.

preservation_requirements: Change only one contextlib.closing import and the two fixture with-statements; retain the connection context for commit/rollback before closure.
Preserve all 15 methods, all assertions, SQL, owner/profile/repository/role/revocation checks and the existing TemporaryDirectory cleanup.
Do not ignore cleanup errors, add retries or sleeps, raise timeouts, skip tests, force garbage collection or alter production code.
Do not execute providers, network, models, Android, Kotlin or a replacement application harness.

validation.baseline: The existing test file ran15 methods with14 passes and one cleanup error on each hosted Windows3.12 and3.13 job at650. All15 fairness methods passed separately in both jobs.
validation.whole_file_inverse: PASS: remove the sole closing import and reverse exactly two with-statements to reconstruct every byte of the8e parent test file.
validation.method_preservation: All15 existing method identities and all105 assertion source segments are preserved. Fourteen method ASTs are identical; only two with-statements in the paired-score method change. No new tests or assertions are added.
validation.syntax: Both complete parent and candidate files parse with the standard Python AST parser. This is a static check, not test execution.

local_dependency_preflight.policy: No packages installed, no substitute harness, no unqualified ordinary test run.

validation.windows_requirement: The normal corrected-source Windows3.12 and3.13 Gateway jobs must execute this exact existing file successfully. A Linux pass would not establish Windows behavior.

integration_requirements: Root owns independent review and latest-source composition without dropping concurrent commits.
Refresh exact release scope and generated references after composition; the changed packaged test requires a Gateway manifest bound to an actual reachable source anchor.
Retain current fairness, native, pronunciation, privacy and recovery controls and all final-head/main/publication requirements.
Canonical and immutable commit/tree receipts remain separate from this ledger; no standalone component publication is claimed.
implementation: Import contextlib.closing once and wrap both direct fixture connections with closing(...), retaining each db transaction context.
Context exit commits or rolls back first, then closes the same connection, including exceptional exits.
All production files, existing SQL operations, owner/profile/repository/role/revocation assertions and cleanup behavior remain unchanged.
